excerpt: The weekly segment in which Anthony touches down on some of the best and worst tracks he has heard in the past week.

title: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard - The Lord of Lightning Vs. Balrog
excerpt: In lieu of a mere single, here is the entire second chapter of King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard‘s three-chapter concept album Murder of the Universe. This will be the psych rock experimentalists’ second album of 2017, following the great Flying Microtonal Banana, and the ‘gimmick’ this time around is the addition of a spoken word narrative to the mix. I’m not sure the band’s gonna meet their goal of five albums this year, but so far I think they’re pacing themselves well and are finding int

title: Denzel Curry - "Ultimate" (BBNG Sessions)
excerpt:
Denzel Curry and BADBADNOTGOOD each embark upon one of their most ambitious musical undertakings by reinventing banger-of-the-decade contender “Ultimate” with live instrumentation. I’m more surprised by the trippy video than I am the fact they pull it off. Feels like I dropped acid…or edited a thatistheplan video.


Denzel and BBNG also produced a live version of Imperial cut “Sick & Tired” during this session, which you can check out here.

title: Todd Terje - "Maskindans" (Det Gylne Triangel Cover)
excerpt: Todd Terje teases toward his beautifully-titled sophomore album Numero Twomero with a lengthy cover of “Maskindans,” an obscure piece of ’80s minimal synth from fellow Norwegian dance music duo Det Gylne Triangel. Naturally, this new version is a lot brighter and dancier, but it also features new vocal contributions from the original artists themselves. So, credit to Todd for modernizing this hidden gem and introducing it to a wider audience.

title: Radiohead - "I Promise"
excerpt: The 20th anniversary reissue of Radiohead’s seminal album OK Computer is coming out later this month, containing of course a remastered version of the album, as well as a bonus disc of b-sides and previously unreleased material. The long passed-over “I Promise” is one of the three unreleased tracks that kicks off the disc, and it’s been paired with an equally pensive video. The uncanny valley is real with this one.

title: Brockhampton - "Gold"
excerpt: LA-based hip hop collective/boyband Brockhampton is releasing its second mixtape, Saturation, next month. Coming off strong singles like “Heat,” “Face,” and now “Gold,” it’s become one of my most highly anticipated projects this year.

title: Chromatics - "Shadow"
excerpt: Chromatics were featured in last week’s premiere of the new Twin Peaks series, and their soothing dream pop sound was just what viewers needed after two hours of Lynchian horror. Here’s the song they played as the credits rolled; it’s set to appear on the soundtrack Twin Peaks (Music from the Limited Event Series), out September 8 via Rhino.

title: Omar Souleyman - "Chobi"
excerpt: Omar Souleyman is dropping his new album To Syra, With Love on June 2 via Diplo’s Mad Decent label, and it’s great to hear the singer’s magnetic style of dabke continue to break through in the West. This latest single, “Chobi,” is probably his most techno-oriented offering yet.

title: Iglooghost - Chalk Shrine 「Mix」
excerpt: Iglooghost has finished work on his debut album for Brainfeeder, which is due to drop sometime in summer! I’m obviously excited cause his Chinese Nü Yr EP was one of my favorite releases of 2015, but in the meantime, we’ve got this running mix that contains some new material to whet our appetites a little bit more.

excerpt: Poppy has done the Poppiest thing imaginable and created a love song for her computer, and of course there’s a video attached to it that has that Poppy aesthetic. We’ve reached peak levels of Poppy, people. I love it.

title: Guerilla Toss - "The String Game"
excerpt: Guerilla Toss continues in the direction of catchy and jerky dance-punk with “The String Game,” the lead single from their new album GT ULTRA. This’ll be the band’s second full-length release on DFA Records, with a June 23 street date. The track’s quasi-lyric video is pretty cool, featuring an abstract and grimy animation style.

title: Fleet Foxes - "Fool's Errand"
excerpt: The latest single from Fleet Foxes‘ long-awaited third album receives a strange and cinematic music video. Crack-Up will be released officially (wink) on June 16 via Nonesuch.

title: Witch Vomit - "Doomed in the Realm of the Dead"
excerpt:
Poisoned Blood by Witch Vomit



A single from Poisoned Blood, an upcoming EP by Portland death metal trio Witch Vomit, out June 30 via 20 Buck Spin.

title: billy woods - "Groundhogs Day"
excerpt:
billy woods has shared the lead single and video from Known Unknowns, the follow-up to 2015’s Today, I Wrote Nothing. That album was woods’ most abstract project to date, but with “Groundhogs Day” we seem to be picking up more where his 2013 album, Dour Candy, left off. Blockhead is even back to doing most of the production, and contrary to (un)popular belief, I do not hate him at all.


Known Unknowns drops June 9 via Backwoodz Studioz.

title: Miya Folick - "Trouble Adjusting"
excerpt: Miya Folick, the latest signee of Terrible Records, comes through with a single that rekindles the spirit of ’90s alt-rock and announces her as a singer-songwriter worth keeping an eye on. The track will appear on Miya’s sophomore EP, Give It to Me, which is due out sometime in summer.

title: HMLTD - "Music!"
excerpt: London post-punk act HMLTD has released a video for “Music!”, the B-side of last month’s fantastic “To the Door” single, and well, please heed the seizure warning. Hopefully a debut album’s on the way cause these two songs have been interesting to say the least.

title: Kirin J. Callinan - "S.A.D."
excerpt: With “S.A.D,” Kirin J. Callinan delivers a cheesy, industrial-tinged ballad about drugs that may lack the sex appeal of previous single “Bravado,” but is still too slick and weird for me to resist. Kirin’s new album, also titled Bravado, is out June 9 via Terrible Records.

title: Wanlov the Kubolor - "We Didn't" ft. Open Mike Eagle
excerpt:
Orange Card – Fruitopian Raps by Wanlov The Kubolor



It’s been ten years since Wanlov the Kubolor a.k.a. The African Gypsy dropped his debut album Green Card, and to commemorate this, he has come through with Orange Card – Fruitopian Raps, probably the most ambitious installment of his color card series so far. It’s already out via Ghanaian label Pidgen Music, but above you can hear a highlight featuring none other than Open Mike Eagle.

title: Noctem - "A Cruce Salus"
excerpt:
Noctem is a melodic blackened death metal outfit hailing from Valencia, Spain that just dropped its fourth album, Haeresis, last September. Already the band is back to dish out some more devastation with new single “A Cruce Salus.” If you dig what you hear, check out the recent album below:



Haeresis by Noctem

title: Forest Swords - "Panic"
excerpt:
With latest single “Panic,” Forest Swords continues to refine his mysterious and woodsy style of ambient dub and offers an equally mysterious and woodsy set of visuals. The track appears on his new LP Compassion, out May 5 via Ninja Tune.


Also wanna note his 45 minute remix of Björk’s “Stonemilker”…

title: The Mountain Goats - "Rain in Soho"
excerpt: More so than on the previous teaser track, The Mountain Goats live up to the title of their forthcoming album Goths here on the opener “Rain in Soho.” This song actually finds the band on some gothic, post-punky shit and it should set the tone for the album quite nicely. Goths is out May 19 via Merge.

title: Algiers - "The Underside of Power"
excerpt: Ready to follow up their awesome self-titled debut, industrial gospel outfit Algiers have unleashed the title track of their sophomore effort The Underside of Power. Peep the ecstatically dark and rebellious video for it above and look forward to the album dropping June 23 via Matador!

title: Tunnelvisions - "Tanami"
excerpt:
Tanami by Tunnelvisions



Dutch production duo Tunnelvisions come through with sprawling, psychedelic, and vaguely exotic breed of house music that I’m digging a lot. Looking forward to whatever else they’re slated to drop later in the year.

White Suns – Psychic Drift by White Suns



The ear-scorching trio returns with a monolithic single from their forthcoming album Psychic Drift, out June 16 via The Flenser!

excerpt: Fava Bean Pepsi has contributed to Mondo Boy’s soundtrack for the film Shangri-La Suite with a cover of “Who Loves the Sun,” the opener of The Velvet Underground’s final (shut up) album Loaded. If you dig the vibe of the track, I guess you can just keep listening to the rest of the tape – Foxygen’s Jonathan Rado covers Loaded cut “I Found a Reason” at about 22:22 too.

We dug the album quite a bit, thinking the twosome came through with something thoughtful and left-field, so we’re happy to premiere this new video for cut “Nothing Moves.” Find that above and, in case you missed it, Anthony’s review here. Happy viewing!

title: GABI - "Love Song" (Video)
excerpt: Back in spring, New York art pop musician GABI put out her debut album Sympathy on Software. Today she shared a desert-set video for cut “Love Song” and a handful of West Coast tour dates, which you can find above and below, respectively. Enjoy!

title: Roots Manuva - "One Thing"
excerpt: Seasoned UK hip hop artist Roots Manuva is releasing a new LP called Bleeds on October 30 via Big Dada. We’re digging on the lead single up there and hope you do too.

title: Deafheaven - "Come Back"
excerpt: Here’s the second single from Deafheaven’s upcoming album New Bermuda, out October 2 via Anti-. Can’t wait to hear the whole thing!

title: Battles - "The Yabba" (Video)
excerpt: Battles’ third album La Di Da Di is in stores this Friday (and is still streaming on NPR Music at the moment). The sublime lead single and opening track “The Yabba” has received a fun video, which you can watch above in case you can’t get enough of this song. We certainly can’t.

title: Deerhunter - "Breaker" (Video)
excerpt: This second single and video from Deerhunter’s upcoming Fading Frontier finds Bradford Cox and Lockett Pundt pulling off their first recorded duet. The album drops October 16 via 4AD; let us know if ya’ll are stoked for it!

title: Troum & raison d'être - De Aeris in Sublunaria Influxu
excerpt:
De Aeris In Sublunaria Influxu by Troum & raison d'être



Here’s a vivid collaborative album by German and Swedish drone outfits Troum and raison d’être, out now via Essence. Enjoy!

title: DOOMSTARKS - "Lively Hood"
excerpt: The latest entry into the Adult Swim Singles series comes from DOOMSTARKS, the duo of DOOM and Ghostface Killah. We’ve been anticipating a full-length effort from the twosome since 2011 and had since lost hope for it seeing the light of day, but this two minute morsel has gotten our mouths watering again. DOOMSTARKS soon?!

title: Ghost - "From the Pinnacle to the Pit" (Video)
excerpt: “From the Pinnacle to the Pit,” a single and highlight from Ghost’s fantastic third album Meliora, has been given a video that provides an origin story for new frontman Papa Emeritus III. Meliora is out now via Loma Vista; find Anthony’s review here.

title: Thighpaulsandra - "The Golden Communion"
excerpt: After almost a decade of near silence from Thighpaulsandra, the Welsh experimental electronic musician makes a grand return with The Golden Communion, his double-length debut on Editions Mego. Hear the 25-minute-long title track and centerpiece above and enjoy!

title: Nyx - Home (Trailer)
excerpt: On October 30, German black metal duo Nyx will release its debut album Home on Agonia Records. The song segments in the above trailer sound pretty compelling, so we’ll be keeping an ear out for these ladies.

title: Flatbush ZOMBiES - "Blacktivist" (Video)
excerpt: Brooklyn hip hop trio Flatbush ZOMBiES has just shared a new song and video titled “Blacktivist.” The track is set to appear on an EP later this year, but along with the video, it is part of a larger video installation by Mario Pfeifer that can be viewed until October 25 at New York’s Ludlow 38. Look into that, catch it if you can, and get psyched for what these guys have coming down the pipeline.

title: Jay Rock - "Vice City" ft. Black Hippy (Video)
excerpt: YES! Jay Rock’s much-anticipated sophomore album 90059 is being released digitally tonight by Top Dawg Entertainment. Until it’s made available for you, check out this video for cut “Vice City,” which features the rest of Jay’s Black Hippy posse.

title: Kurt Vile - "Life Like This" (Video)
excerpt: As previously mentioned, Philly singer-songwriter Kurt Vile has an upcoming album called b’lieve i’m goin down due out September 25th via Matador. Now, in this video for new single “Life Like This,” you can embark upon a trip with him through director Adam Avilla‘s animated world. Enjoy!

title: Kendrick Lamar - To Pimp a Butterfly Medley (Live)
excerpt:
Last night on the Late Show with Stephen Colbert, Kendrick Lamar performed a medley of four songs from his recent masterpiece To Pimp a Butterfly – “Wesley’s Theory,” “Momma,” “King Kunta,” and “u.” Previously, Kendrick appeared as the final musical guest of The Colbert Report, performing an awesome unreleased track:







Get More: Comedy Central,Funny Videos,Funny TV Shows

title: Soldiers of Fortune - "Nails"
excerpt: Soldiers of Fortune, an anti-supergroup comprised of members from Oneida, Home, and Chavez, is releasing its second album Early Risers on November 6 via Mexican Summer. Judging from this lead single “Nails,” these guys are gonna come through with a set of the year’s most freewheeling, DGAF jams. Enjoy!

title: Loma Prieta - "Love" (Video)
excerpt: San Francisco screamo band Loma Prieta is back with a new album called Self Portrait, out October 2 on Deathwish. Watch the video for new single “Love” up there and here’s a gentle reminder that the group’s 2012 effort I.V. is stellar:

title: DedekindCut - Thot eNhançer EP
excerpt:
Thot eNhançer (ep/single) by DedekindCut



Today, the producer formerly known as Lee Bannon released a new single and EP under the pseudonym DedekindCut. Enjoy Thot eNhançer above and find some quick thoughts on Bannon’s latest project, Pattern of Excel, in this past month’s YUNOREVIEW.

title: The World is a Beautiful Place & I am No Longer Afraid to Die - "January 10th, 2014" / "I Can Be Afraid of Anything"
excerpt:
Harmlessness by The World is a Beautiful Place & I am No Longer Afraid to Die



CT post-emo outfit The World is a Beautiful Place… is due to drop its sophomore album Harmlessness on September 25 via Epitaph. As of today, two singles have been released, which you can peep above and below. And find Anthony’s positive review for the band’s debut here.

title: Laetitia Sadier - "Then, I Will Love You Again" (Video)
excerpt: A year ago, Drag City put out Something Shines, the third full-length solo effort by Stereolab frontwoman Laetitia Sadier. The album’s second track has just received a video, which you can give a watch up there. Quite striking!

title: milo - "zen scientist" ft. Myka 9
excerpt:
so the flies don't come by milo



Milo is releasing a new tape called so the flies don’t come on September 25 via Milwaukee label Ruby Yacht. The project is produced entirely by Kenny Segal and in its relatively short tracklist packs some interesting features; really looking forward to hearing what Hemlock Ernst brings to the table here. Check out a cut featuring LA rapper Myka 9 above and, below, listen to Milo on a recent episode of our podcast wherein he sheds some light on the album. Also,

title: Sivyj Yar - "The Snow shall fall a long while"
excerpt:
Burial Shrouds by Sivyj Yar



Here’s the glorious closing track from Russian black metal act Sivyj Yar’s new album Burial Shrouds, out today via Avantgarde. We’ll come back to this in a few months when we’re being battered by another brutal New England winter.

title: Roma Amor - "Der treue Husar" (Video)
excerpt: Dark cabaret outfit Roma Amor has a new album out on Old Europa Cafe called Una torbida estate. A couple of spots feature lyrics from traditional German songs, including this bittersweet number you might recognize from the end of Kubrick’s Paths of Glory.

title: Gregory Pepper & His Problems - Chorus! Chorus! Chorus! EP
excerpt:
CHORUS! CHORUS! CHORUS! by Gregory Pepper & His Problems



Ontario singer-songwriter Gregory Pepper delivers a series of power pop vignettes on Chorus! Chorus! Chorus!, out now via Fake Four. You can tell from the name of his band that this is problematic stuff, so listen above at your own discretion.

title: Nickelus F & Shawn Kemp - Trick Dice
excerpt:
TRICK DICE by NICKELUS F & SHAWN KEMP



With the delay of his reportedly final album Oblivion Access, Lil Ugly Mane has kindly shared Trick Dice, a collaboration between his production moniker Shawn Kemp and fellow Richmond rapper Nickelus F. The project will be released on tape by Ormolycka eventually.

title: Naps - You Will Live in a Cool Box EP
excerpt:
You Will Live in a Cool Box by Naps



Here’s a sweet bedroom rock/pop EP from Tallahassee quartet Naps, out via Viridian Sounds. Happy listening!

title: Marreck - Yuda EP
excerpt:
Marreck- Yuda by Alien Jams



Michael Hahn, a producer hailing from North East England and founder of Reject and Fade, assumes his Marreck pseudonym for Yuda, five tracks of biting tech-drones released yesterday as a 12″ by London imprint Alien Jams.

title: Žen - Jantar
excerpt:
Jantar by Žen



If you’re looking for a powerful post-rock release, Zagreb’s Žen has you covered with its sophomore album Jantar, out via Unrecords. Enjoy!

title: Car Seat Headrest - "Something Soon" (Video)
excerpt: Lo-fi indie act Car Seat Headrest is set to make its label debut with Teens of Style, out October 30 via Matador. Above, find the video for “Something Soon,” a catchy as hell single that maintains enough of the earlier, self-released work’s grit.

title: Jeffrey Lewis - "Outta Town"
excerpt: Jeffrey Lewis comes through with a quirky folk-punk tune that deserves a spot on any mixtape made for a crush. Taken from his upcoming album with Los Bolts, Manhattan, out October 30 via Rough Trade.

title: BROCKHAMPTON - "Dirt"
excerpt: BROCKHAMPTON is an abstract hip hop supergroup from Texas, comprised of Kevin Abstract, JOBA, Ameer Vann, Matt Champion, Dom McLennon, Rodney Tenor, and Merlyn Wood. Last week, they dropped an intriguing single on Fool’s Gold called “Dirt,” which you can check out above. I dig the strangeness and think these guys have a ton of potential.

title: Autre Ne Veut - "World War Pt. 2" (Ash Koosha Remix)
excerpt: Back in June, London-based producer Ash Koosha made his Olde English Spelling Bee debut with GUUD, one of Anthony’s favorite electronic releases so far this year. Now he’s back with a remix for his former labelmate Autre Ne Veut, who’s dropping his third album Age of Transparency on October 2 through Downtown. Ash has glitched the fuck out of the lead single; check out his mindbending results above and hear him on our podcast here. Enjoy!

title: Oneohtrix Point Never - "I Bite Through It" / Kaoss Edge - Platitudes
excerpt: At long last, here’s the lead single from Oneohtrix Point Never’s upcoming album Garden of Delete, out November 13 via Warp. Meanwhile, there’s mystery mounting over unknown “hypergrunge” band Kaoss Edge, who released a couple of songs yesterday and was named in 0PN’s promotional materials. Get ready to go deep, fellas.

title: Cantique Lépreux - "La Meute"
excerpt:

title: Shaidar Logoth - Chapter II: The Ritualist
excerpt:
Chapter II: The Ritualist by Shaidar Logoth



One of the most powerful atmospheric black metal releases I’ve heard this year, courtesy of Minneapolis’ Shaidar Logoth.

title: Tiny Little Houses - "Soon We Won't Exist"
excerpt: Check out this fuzzed-out pop rock magic from Melbourne quartet Tiny Little Houses, to land on new EP You Tore My Heart Out September 25.

title: Battles - "FF Bada"
excerpt: Today, Battles dropped another wonderful single from its upcoming third album La Di Da Di, out September 18 via Warp. Enjoy!

title: YUNOREVIEW: August 2015
excerpt: The magical monthly segment where Anthony briefly touches down on a gauntlet of albums he didn’t get a chance to review this past month. These are just his short, straightforward, passionate, biased opinions.

title: BLKHRTS - Dead Drops Vol. 1
excerpt: Noisy gothic hip hop from Denver’s BLKHRTS, released as a heart-shaped 12″ earlier this year by Deathbomb Arc. “May GOTH be with you!”

title: チェスマスター - 非実体
excerpt:
非実体 by チェスマスター



One of the lushest and prettiest vaporwave project’s I’ve heard yet, out via Dream Catalogue.

title: Author & Punisher - Melk en Honing
excerpt:
MELK EN HONING by Author & Punisher



A little late getting to this latest album from industrial metal act Author & Punisher, which was released at June’s end by Housecore.  Definitely check it out if you’re in the mood for a pummeling and entrancing experience!

title: Diet Cig - "Sleep Talk" / "Dinner Date"
excerpt:
Sleep Talk/Dinner Date 7" by Diet Cig



Sweet new 7″ from twee pop duo Diet Cig, out September 18 via Father/Daughter Records. Quite heartfelt and endearing!

title: Haleek Maul - "Elation" (Demo) / "Feuer" ft. Kill J
excerpt: Yesterday, Barbados-based rapper/producer Haleek Maul continued teasing his upcoming mixtape King Midas with the above demo “Elation,” which has a cool trap-flavored atmosphere and makes good us of autotune, and the below track “Feuer,” featuring Danish singer Kill J. Looking forward to the tape!

title: Blue Sky Black Death - Stonedstrumentals
excerpt:
Stonedstrumentals by Blue Sky Black Death



Production duo Blue Sky Black Death has released the instrumentals from January’s Stoned & Dethroned, its fourth collaborative project with rapper Nacho Picaso. Enjoy!

Harm by Infinity Girl



Here’s a really cool noise rock/shoegaze project from Boston’s Infinity Girl. It’s the band’s Top Shelf debut and is out now. Props to them for sending some of the proceeds to Nepal.

title: Adam Rudolph / Go: Organic Guitar Orchestra - "Heliotropic"
excerpt:
Turning Towards The Light [24 bit / 48khz] by Adam Rudolph / Go: Organic Guitar Orchestra



An intricate electric guitar piece from Adam Rudolph and Go: Organic Guitar Orchestra’s forthcoming LP Turning Towards the Light, out October 2 on Cuneiform Records. Enjoy!

title: Bloodway - Mapping the Moment with the Logic of Dreams
excerpt:
Mapping The Moment With The Logic Of Dreams by BLOODWAY



Romanian trio Bloodway comes through with a kick ass dark metal project with debut album Mapping the Moment with the Logic of Dreams. Check it out ahead of its September 25 release via I, Voidhanger.

title: Premiere: Surface to Air Missive - "Going Out" (Video)
excerpt: Tallahassee psych pop outfit Surface to Air Missive is putting out its sophomore album Third Missive this fall via Olde English Spelling Bee. The project will find the band expanding its instrumental palette with keys and woodwinds, adopting a more baroque aesthetic, and we’re stoked to premiere the lead single and its accompanying video above. These guys have come through with some serious earworms in the past and this is another one! Below you can check out a couple of non-album tracks

title: Mgła - Exercises in Futility
excerpt: Kraków black metal outfit Mgła is releasing its third LP Exercises in Futility September 4 via Northern Heritage. Press play to experience all the ferocity now!

title: Destroyer - Poison Season
excerpt: Destroyer’s latest record continues to show singer-songwriter Dan Bejar’s talents as the modern age’s preeminent rock poet.

title: Mos Def & Ski Beatz - "Sensei on the Block"
excerpt: Mos Def is back with a vengeance on this new Ski Beatz-produced track. Enjoy!

title: Mark Kozelek Starter Pack
excerpt: 2015 has been a very busy year for singer-songwriter Mark Kozelek – since the release of Universal Themes (his seventh album with Sun Kil Moon), he has announced a new EP and spoken word project due out in October via his Caldo Verde label, as well as a full-length collaboration with post-metal act Jesu slated for February. title: Baroness - "Chlorine & Wine"
excerpt: Sludge metal outfit Baroness has announced Purple, the follow-up to its 2012 double-album Yellow & Green.  It is due out December 18 via the band’s new Abraxan Hymns imprint; check out the lead single “Chlorine & Wine” above.

title: Destroyer - "Times Square" (Video)
excerpt: The centerpiece track of Destroyer’s new record receives a whimsical stop-motion music video. Poison Season is out tomorrow via Dead Oceans.

title: Dâm-Funk - Invite the Light
excerpt: NPR is now streaming Dâm-Funk’s new double-length synth-funk opus, Invite the Light, ahead of its September 4 release via Stones Throw. Also, I recommend checking out this video of Mr. Funk spinning selections from his record collection; it’s pretty long, but will turn you on to some great tunes:

title: Jay Rock - "Easy Bake" ft. Kendrick Lamar & SZA
excerpt: Last night, Jay Rock premiered another cut from his sophomore album 90059. “Easy Bake” features labelmates Kendrick Lamar and SZA (the latter also appears in the recently shared title track). Listen in above and look out for 90059 September 4 on TDE.

title: Big K.R.I.T. - "86"
excerpt:
Today, Big K.R.I.T. celebrated his birthday by giving us this new track “86.” Enjoy and wish the man a happy birthday!


In related news, come October K.R.I.T. will be embarking upon his “Kritically Acclaimed” tour – find dates for that here.

title: Bill Orcutt & Jacob Felix Heule - "Labor and Enchantment"
excerpt: A minute of mayhem from guitarist Bill Orcutt and drummer Jacob Heule, taken from their new record Colonial Donuts, out October 16 via Palilalia. Cover art game on point!

title: Julia Holter - "Sea Calls Me Home"
excerpt: Here’s another glimpse of Julia Holter’s upcoming LP Have You in My Wilderness, out September 25 via Domino. Enjoy!

title: Duane Pitre - Bayou Electric (Excerpt)
excerpt: On September 4, New Orleans ambient musician/minimalist composer Duane Pitre will conclude a trilogy of albums on Important Records with Bayou Electric. Up there is a serene clip from it; happy listening!

title: Prof - "Bar Breaker" (Video)
excerpt: Minneapolis MC Prof comes through with a hilarious video for his latest single, “Bar Breaker!” The track, produced by Aesop Rock, appears on his forthcoming full-length Liability, out October 16 via Rhymesayers Entertainment.

title: Protomartyr - "Dope Cloud"
excerpt: As previously mentioned, Detroit post-punk trio Protomartyr is releasing its third LP, The Agent Intellect, on October 9 via Hardly Art. This is the second single from the project; check it out and let us know if you’re hyped!

title: John Roberts - "Orah"
excerpt: Boiler Room has debuted the title track from Orah, the new EP by Berlin-based deep house producer John Roberts, out September 7 via his Brunette Editions imprint. Enjoy!

title: Bill Ryder-Jones - "Two to Birkenhead" (Video)
excerpt: English singer-songwriter and composer Bill Ryder-Jones is due to release his new album West Kirby County Primary on November 6 via Domino. Above find the video for lead single “Two to Birkenhead,” a frank garage rock tune.

title: Nick Cave - "The Sick Bag Song - Denver" (Video)
excerpt: Nick Cave recites a chapter from his new book The Sick Bag Song, a mystifying account of his 2014 North American tour with The Bad Seeds. It will be released here in the States on September 3 by Canongate.

title: Premiere: Apollo Brown - "Not That Guy" ft. Your Old Droog
excerpt: Michigan producer Apollo Brown is putting out a new album called Grandeur on September 25 through Mello Music Group. Your Old Droog is one of the many names in the project’s all-star cast of MCs and we’re happy to premiere his contribution above. Enjoy!

title: Sexwitch - "Helelyos"
excerpt: Singer-songwriter Natasha Khan (Bat for Lashes), producer Dan Carey, and British psych-rock band TOY have united as Sexwitch. A self-titled debut album of cover songs (mostly culled from 60’s & 70’s Iran, Morocco, and Thailand) is due out September 25 via The Echo Label. Hear the band’s take on Zia Atabay’s “Helelyos” above and the original down here:

title: Kye - Nice Weather for War (Teaser)
excerpt: Graham Lambkin’s Kye label has just released a compilation called Nice Weather for War, showcasing six compelling voices in modern avant-garde music. This video contains snippets of the previously unreleased pieces; enjoy!

title: Here We Go Magic - "Ordinary Feeling"
excerpt: On October 16, Secretly Canadian is putting out Be Small, a new LP from Brooklyn psych-rock/pop band Here We Go Magic. Listen to lead single “Ordinary Feeling” above for good vibes.

title: 食品まつり a.k.a foodman - This is a pen EP
excerpt:
This is a pen EP by 食品まつり a.k.a foodman



Foodman comes through with four more tracks of freaky footwork on today’s This is a pen EP. Happy listening!

title: Shit and Shine - "Ass"
excerpt:
Everybody's A Fuckin Expert by Shit and Shine



A cut from London noise rock act Shit and Shine’s new LP Everybody’s a Fuckin Expert (great titles all around!), out September 4 through Editions Mego. Watch the video below:

title: Low - "Lies"
excerpt: The second single from slowcore outfit Low’s latest album Ones and Sixes, out September 11 via Sub Pop.

title: Hijokaidan - "Emergency Stairway to Heaven Part 3"
excerpt: Excerpt from enduring Japanoise act Hijokaidan’s new album Emergency Stairway to Heaven, out August 31 via Cold Spring. Enjoy!

title: Rapsody - "Don't Need It Remix" ft. Joey Bada$$ & Merna
excerpt: “Don’t Need It,” a highlight from Rapsody’s Beauty and the Beast EP that featured a sweet hook from singer-songwriter Merna, has managed to get even hotter with the addition of Joey Bada$$ on this new remix. Enjoy!

title: Black Breath - "Slaves Beyond Death"
excerpt: Slaves Beyond Death, the third album by Seattle death ‘n’ roll outfit Black Breath, is due out September 25 via Southern Lord. Listen to the savage title track up there and find Anthony’s glowing review of the band’s 2012 sophomore LP Sentenced to Life here.

title: The Underachievers - "Chasing Faith x Rain Dance x Allusions" (Video)
excerpt: The Underachievers have release a new video combining three tracks from their upcoming album Evermore – The Art of Duality. Watch it above and look out for the project September 25 on RPM MSC.

title: Anna Þorvaldsdóttir - In the Light of Air
excerpt: NPR is streaming Icelandic composer Anna Þorvaldsdóttir’s new work In the Light of Air ahead of its August 28 release on Sono Luminus. Listen in if you’re in the mood for haunting music evocative of a remote land.

title: Kyary Pamyu Pamyu - "Crazy Party Night ～ぱんぷきんの逆襲～" (Video)
excerpt: Pretty much every Kyary Pamyu Pamyu video is a party, but this might be the partiest yet.  The “Crazy Party Night” single will be released September 2 via unBORDE. Happy listening/viewing!

title: Panda Bear - "No Mans Land"
excerpt: Today Panda Bear released a new EP called Crosswords; check out one of the new cuts above and find our review of his latest album, Panda Bear Meets the Grim Reaper, here.

title: Patti Smith - "Aqua Teen Dream"
excerpt: Here’s Patti Smith’s “haunting elegy” from the Aqua Teen Hunger Force series finale, “The Last One Forever and Ever (For Real This Time) (We … Mean It),” which airs this Sunday at midnight. It’s OK to cry.

title: RiFF RAFF x Danny Brown - "WETTER THAN TSUNAMi" (Video)
excerpt: RiFF RAFF and Danny Brown have joined forces for a single called “WETTER THAN TSUNAMi.” You know this is gonna be good.

title: Ulfuls - 『ロッキン50肩ブギウギックリ腰』 (Video)
excerpt: Osaka pop rock outfit Ulfuls just dropped a bonkers video for 『ロッキン50肩ブギウギックリ腰』; watch it above and enjoy! The track is from Born to Be Wai Wai, out September 9 via Warner Music Japan.

title: Bones - "TheDifferenceBetweenUs" (Video)
excerpt: From Bones’ new project Banshee, out August 23 through his TeamSESH imprint. Try the lead single “BeanNighe” if you’ve yet to, as well:

title: Bill Horist - "Kirin"
excerpt: Whimsical track from Mutei – Music for Davida Monk’s Dream Pavilion, the new album by Seattle-based prepared-guitarist Bill Horist, out September 4 via Important Records. Enjoy!

title: Yasiin Bey - "Basquiat Ghostwriter" (Video)
excerpt: Yasiin Bey has released a new single and music video inspired by police brutality and the art of Basquiat on the website A Country Called Earth. Tune in to it above and read Bey’s accompanying statement here.

title: Anna von Hausswolff - "Come Wander with Me/Deliverance"
excerpt: Swedish singer-songwriter Anna von Hausswolff is releasing her third album The Miraculous November 13 via Other Music. Judging from this leviathan of a lead single, things are gonna get real dark and heavy!

title: Kevin Drumm & Jason Lescalleet - Night and Day EP
excerpt:
Night and Day by Kevin Drumm & Jason Lescalleet



A couple of noisy drones with a nocturnal theme from Kevin Drumm & Jason Lescalleet, hinting toward a second collaborative album they’re set to release via Erstwhile in October. These tracks leave us wondering if it’ll be even darker than last year’s The Abyss.

title: 99LETTERS - "Do Acid"
excerpt: Great groove from Japanese producer 99LETTERS, taken from his forthcoming tape on THRHNDRDSVNTNN Drawing Days. Enjoy!

title: Oneohtrix Point Never - "Flame"
excerpt: Here’s a preview of Oneohtrix Point Never‘s purportedly dank new album Garden of Delete, out November 13 through Warp.

title: Hong Kong Express - This

This by Hong Kong Express



London vaporwave artist Hong Kong Express concludes his “Hong Kong Tetralogy” with This, out today via Adhesive Sounds. Check it out above and find Anthony’s discussion with HKE down here (at the 38 minute mark):

title: Serge Gainsbourg Starter Pack
excerpt:
Say what you will about Serge Gainsbourg, that he and his music were overly lewd or whatever; he was arguably the most significant voice in 20th century French pop music. Even when he was penning albums comprised mostly of shit humor (Vu de l’extérieur), the man was delivering some magnetic tunes. He was also pretty prolific during the three decades he was musically active, thus making him the perfect subject for one of these starter pack features.

excerpt: The opening track of atmospheric black metal outfit Deafheaven’s third album New Bermuda, out October 2 via Anti-. Enjoy!

title: Jay Rock - "90059" (Video)
excerpt: TDE rapper Jay Rock has a druggy drift through LA with labelmate SZA in this video for recent single “90059.” It’s the title track of his debut LP, which is said to be out sometime this year.

title: MANAS - "No Oracles"
excerpt:
The opening track from improvisational rock duo MANAS’ self-titled debut LP, out September 4 via Feeding Tube. If you dig what you hear, there’s a lot more where that came from on the double-cassette they put out last month:

title: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard - "Paper Mâché Dream Balloon"
excerpt: The title track from Melbourne psych-rock outfit King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard’s new and magically-titled album Paper Mâché Dream Balloon, out November 13 via ATO Records. Happy listening!

In honor of the recent release of Frank Zappa’s 100th and final album Dance Me This, Anthony and I have compiled a career-spanning playlist to act as a gateway to the man’s music — or if you’re already into it, a celebration. For his imaginative and lighthearted approach to composition and songwriting, as well as his mastery of rock, jazz, and classical styles, we consider Frank one of the greatest minds in 20th century music.

title: I like the Bandcamp platform.
excerpt:
As as part of my ongoing videos talking about streaming services and contemporary music consumption, I thought I’d talk about a platform that isn’t discussed alongside the Spotifys and Tidals of the world: Bandcamp.


Bandcamp and democratized content platforms like it, I think, are an essential part of the online music market in that that allow an open exchange of artistic ideas between musicians and fans.
